body.statement: If \(J_x=\varnothing\) for some stratum, or if the carrierwise marginal ranges cannot solve the coupled observed-cell and shared-contrast equations, characterize the global target secants across all compatible latent representations and determine whether annihilation of \(R_0\mathcal N_Q^{\pm}\) for every compatible completion \(Q\) is sufficient for global point identification across disconnected support faces.

obligation.what_is_open: Whether annihilation of \(R_0\mathcal N_Q^{\pm}\) for every compatible completion is sufficient for global point identification when a common carrier is empty or coupled support restrictions prevent the carrier lift.
obligation.obstruction: The proved linear system is local and fixes one latent representation and its support face.  The compatible full-data fiber may have disconnected components with different proxy factorizations or outcome supports, and the frozen assumptions provide neither path connectedness nor a reduction of global secants to local tangents.
obligation.attempted: The support-restricted observed-cell and shared-contrast equations were proved necessary and sufficient for every frozen-factor two-sided tangent, and the active-carrier construction was used to close all nonempty-carrier surjective cases.  A path-integration promotion stops because arbitrary compatible completions need not be joined within one support face.
obligation.partial_result: For each fixed compatible completion \(Q\), the proposition on fixed-completion support-face tangents gives the exact computable space \(R_0\mathcal N_Q^{\pm}\) of two-sided target directions by Gaussian elimination, without dividing by entries of \(C_x\).  The active-carrier signed-cell theorem additionally closes every case with nonempty \(J_x\) and carrierwise anchor-zero support-tangent surjectivity, even when \(C_x\) has zeros outside \(J_x\).  What remains is a global secant problem when a common carrier is empty or coupled support restrictions prevent the carrier lift.

body.justification: After the active-carrier theorem, only empty carriers or genuinely coupled deficient support ranges remain outside the constructive converse.
body.gap: It remains unknown whether annihilating every fixed-completion tangent space eliminates target-changing secants between disconnected latent representations.
body.consumer: Resolving the global secant question would determine the last exact-identification boundary for sparse assay categories and outcome supports.
